tooltip.simpletweaks.claim_deed.inactive: Right-click: claims the chunk you stand in.
config.simpletweaks.claims.enabled.toolt:
Server-side claims: /claim create claims your
chunk; only you and trusted players may change
it. Explosions, fire, fluids, pistons,
automation, mobs and tools respect claims. An
existing file keeps its value. Default: true.
config.simpletweaks.claims.maxClaimsPerP:
Global per-player limit across dimensions.
Range 1–256. Existing claims are retained if
the limit is lowered. Default: 16.
config.simpletweaks.claims.maxTrustedPla:
Maximum trusted UUIDs per claim. Range 0–64.
Existing trusts are retained if the limit is
lowered. Default: 8.
config.simpletweaks.claims.globalCap.too:
Maximum total claims across dimensions. Range
1–10000. Existing claims are never silently
removed. Default: 4096.
config.simpletweaks.claims.cooldownTicks:
Server ticks between successful claim, trust,
revocation or removal operations by one
player. Range 20–72000, across dimensions;
resets on restart. Default: 100 ticks.
config.simpletweaks.claims.opBypass.tool:
Only operators at permission level 4 may
bypass protection when enabled. Does not
bypass claim caps, spawn or world-border
policy. Default: false.
config.simpletweaks.claims.spawnBuffer.t:
Claims cannot intersect the world-spawn
square. Range 0–256; Vanilla spawn protection
is always respected. Default: 16 blocks.
config.simpletweaks.claims.dimensions.to:
Allowlist for new claims; up to 32 dimension
IDs. Existing claims in other dimensions
remain protected. Entire chunks must be
inside the world border.
Default: Overworld, Nether, End.

simpletweaks.deed.help.text:
One line per person: name or UUID, a colon, then letters or a role.

B Build, D Destroy, U Use (doors, buttons, workbenches, beds), C Container (chests, frames, pickup), R Redstone, A Animals and vehicles, M Manage (change this code).

Roles: @guest = U, @helper = UCA, @member = BDUCRA, @manager = all.

*: U gives every player a right.
[12,-4] starts a section that replaces the rules of that chunk.
A # starts a comment.

simpletweaks.guide.page.1.title: Simple Tweaks
simpletweaks.guide.page.1: Legacy compatibility and server-authoritative claims, on by default.
simpletweaks.guide.page.2.title: Legacy World Compatibility
simpletweaks.guide.page.2: An exact whitelist resolves old item, block, block entity, and component names to
simpletweaks.guide.page.3.title: Legacy World Compatibility
simpletweaks.guide.page.3: existing SimpleBuilding registries. Saving uses the current names. No duplicate gameplay content is registered.
simpletweaks.guide.page.4.title: Claims (On by Default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.4: Server-authoritative claims, on by default: /simpletweaks claim create (or a legacy deed) claims the chunk you stand in;
simpletweaks.guide.page.5.title: Claims (On by Default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.5: only you and players you trust may build, break, open containers, use vehicles or take items there.
simpletweaks.guide.page.6.title: Claims (On by Default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.6: Explosions, fire, fluids, pistons, automation, projectiles, mob griefing, attractors and SimpleBuilding's area tools respect claims. Mobs still fight normally inside claims.
simpletweaks.guide.page.7.title: Claims (On by Default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.7: Server admins can switch claims off in config/simpletweaks-claims.json; an existing file keeps its value. Default: true.
simpletweaks.guide.page.8.title: Claim Deed
simpletweaks.guide.page.8: Craft paper, an ink sac and honeycomb into an empty Claim Deed. Right-click it to claim the chunk you stand in; the deed is then bound to you. A bound deed opens the rights editor of your land:
simpletweaks.guide.page.9.title: Claim Deed
simpletweaks.guide.page.9: one line per person, a name or UUID, a colon, then the letters B Build, D Destroy, U Use, C Container,
simpletweaks.guide.page.10.title: Claim Deed
simpletweaks.guide.page.10: R Redstone, A Animals and vehicles, M Manage, or a role (@guest, @helper, @member, @manager). *: U gives every player a right;
simpletweaks.guide.page.11.title: Claim Deed
simpletweaks.guide.page.11: [x,z] starts a section for one chunk. Done saves; the server checks the code again and answers with the line of every error. Copy a bound deed with an empty one in the crafting grid; a copy cannot be copied.
simpletweaks.guide.page.12.title: Claim Deed
simpletweaks.guide.page.12: Anybody else holding a deed sees only what they may do.
simpletweaks.guide.page.13.title: Claim Table
simpletweaks.guide.page.13: Craft paper and a Claim Deed over four planks into a Claim Table. Right-click it to see who claimed what around it:
simpletweaks.guide.page.14.title: Claim Table
simpletweaks.guide.page.14: a chunk raster with one color per owner (your own land framed), three zoom levels, drag to pan, and
simpletweaks.guide.page.15.title: Claim Table
simpletweaks.guide.page.15: an owner list beside it (chunks, only mine, click to center). Terrain is not shown; that is Simple Maps' job.
simpletweaks.guide.page.16.title: Block and container log (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.16: Logs every block a player breaks or places and every item taken from or put into a container block, with player, time, position and dimension.
simpletweaks.guide.page.17.title: Block and container log (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.17: /simpletweaks inspect shows the history of a clicked block, /simpletweaks rollback undoes a player's actions.
simpletweaks.guide.page.18.title: Inventory backups on death (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.18: Before a player drops anything on death, their inventory, armor, offhand, XP, time, cause and position are saved; the last keep deaths (default 5, 1–50) per player stay.
simpletweaks.guide.page.19.title: Inventory backups on death (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.19: /simpletweaks deaths <player> [n] opens them in the admin inventory screen.
simpletweaks.guide.page.20.title: /simpletweaks invsee and /simpletweaks endersee (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.20: Own admin screen in the SimpleLib box style: the target's armor,
simpletweaks.guide.page.21.title: /simpletweaks invsee and /simpletweaks endersee (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.21: offhand, inventory and hotbar (or the ender chest) above your own inventory.
simpletweaks.guide.page.22.title: /simpletweaks invsee and /simpletweaks endersee (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.22: Items can be taken and put live; offline players work too.
simpletweaks.guide.page.23.title: Vanish (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.23: /simpletweaks vanish [player] makes an admin invisible to players below seePermission (default 2): not sent as an entity,
simpletweaks.guide.page.24.title: Vanish (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.24: left out of the tab list and the server list count and sample, no join or leave message.
simpletweaks.guide.page.25.title: Freeze (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.25: /simpletweaks freeze <player> holds a player in place: every move is set back, and breaking, using, placing, attacking and the drop key are refused. A title and an action bar line tell them;
simpletweaks.guide.page.26.title: Freeze (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.27.title: Restart announcements (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.27: Scheduled restart times (times, "HH:mm" in server time) and /simpletweaks restart <minutes> count down in chat at the warning minutes (default 15, 10, 5, 1) and at 30, 10…1 seconds, with a boss bar;
simpletweaks.guide.page.28.title: Restart announcements (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.28: at zero everything is saved and the server stops cleanly.
simpletweaks.guide.page.29.title: Automatic world backups (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.29: Every intervalHours (default 6, 1–168) and with /simpletweaks backup now the world is zipped like save-off, save-all flush, save-on:
simpletweaks.guide.page.30.title: Automatic world backups (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.30: saving pauses, everything is flushed, a worker thread writes the archive, then saving resumes.
simpletweaks.guide.page.31.title: Maintenance mode (switch on, mode off)
simpletweaks.guide.page.31: /simpletweaks maintenance on lets only operators of joinPermission (default 2) and the names or UUIDs in allowed join; everybody else gets kickMessage.
simpletweaks.guide.page.32.title: Maintenance mode (switch on, mode off)
simpletweaks.guide.page.32: The server list shows motd. /simpletweaks maintenance off ends it, /simpletweaks maintenance status tells.
simpletweaks.guide.page.33.title: Lag finder (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.33: /simpletweaks lag [seconds] (default 5, 1–30) measures tick time and TPS, time per block entity type and entity
simpletweaks.guide.page.34.title: Lag finder (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.34: type, the most expensive chunks with their entity and block entity counts, and hints at possible redstone clocks.
simpletweaks.guide.page.35.title: Share coordinates (T4)
simpletweaks.guide.page.35: /simpletweaks coords [message] shares your position with everybody, /simpletweaks coords to <player> [message] with one player.
simpletweaks.guide.page.36.title: Private death hint (T5)
simpletweaks.guide.page.36: After a real death only you get a line with place (copy on click), dimension, cause and how long your items stay (5 minutes while the area is loaded).
simpletweaks.guide.page.37.title: Chat mentions (T6)
simpletweaks.guide.page.37: @Name in chat is highlighted in yellow for everybody, and the mentioned players hear a soft bell.
simpletweaks.guide.page.38.title: /simpletweaks playtime and /simpletweaks seen (T7)
simpletweaks.guide.page.38: /simpletweaks playtime [player] shows the play time from the Vanilla statistics; /simpletweaks seen <player> says whether a player is online or how long ago they left.
simpletweaks.guide.page.39.title: Mob griefing per mob (T8)
simpletweaks.guide.page.39: Listed mobs (blocked, default creeper, enderman, ghast, wither, ravager) cannot change blocks; all other mobs follow the Vanilla rule mob_griefing.
simpletweaks.guide.page.40.title: PvP per player (T9)
simpletweaks.guide.page.40: /simpletweaks pvp on|off (no argument: status). A player can hurt another only when both have PvP on.
simpletweaks.guide.page.41.title: Welcome and announcements (T19)
simpletweaks.guide.page.41: A welcome line for joining players ({player} is replaced), rotating tips every tipMinutes and own join/leave lines instead of the Vanilla ones.
simpletweaks.guide.page.42.title: Daily login reward (T20)
simpletweaks.guide.page.42: The first join of a day gives the reward items; days in a row build a streak, a gap starts again at 1, and every bonusEvery days (default 7) there are bonus items.
simpletweaks.guide.page.43.title: Server events (T21)
simpletweaks.guide.page.43: Operators start events with /simpletweaks event start <double_xp|more_loot|blood_moon> [minutes], stop and status; one event at a time with a boss bar.
simpletweaks.guide.page.44.title: Leaderboard (T22)
simpletweaks.guide.page.44: /simpletweaks leaderboard <playtime|deaths|kills|mined> lists the top 10 of every player known to the server.
simpletweaks.guide.page.45.title: Votes (T23)
simpletweaks.guide.page.45: /simpletweaks vote weather clear and /simpletweaks vote event <name> start a vote with clickable Yes/No; /simpletweaks vote yes|no counts.
simpletweaks.guide.page.46.title: AFK detection (T24)
simpletweaks.guide.page.46: After minutes (default 5) without any action, or with /simpletweaks afk, a player is AFK: grey with [AFK] in the tab list and not counted for sleeping.
simpletweaks.guide.page.47.title: World border per dimension (T25)
simpletweaks.guide.page.47: Entries in border.dimensions (size and center per dimension) are applied to that dimension's world border at server start; /simpletweaks border lists all borders.
simpletweaks.guide.page.48.title: Nether roof lock (T26)
simpletweaks.guide.page.48: Survival and adventure players above Y 127 in the Nether are put back below the roof (last place below it, or a free spot under it).
simpletweaks.guide.page.49.title: Partial keep inventory (T27)
simpletweaks.guide.page.49: While the Vanilla rule keep_inventory is off, part of the inventory stays on death: hotbar_armor (hotbar, armor, offhand), xp (experience) or custom (switches per part and keepXpPercent).
simpletweaks.guide.page.50.title: Dragon egg every fight (T28)
simpletweaks.guide.page.50: Every later dragon kill puts a new dragon egg on the exit portal; if an egg already lies there, it drops as an item.
simpletweaks.guide.page.51.title: Phantoms per player (T30)
simpletweaks.guide.page.51: /simpletweaks phantoms off stops phantoms from spawning for you; /simpletweaks phantoms on brings them back.
simpletweaks.guide.page.52.title: Mob limit per chunk (T31)
simpletweaks.guide.page.52: Every scanSeconds the mobs per chunk are counted; over perChunk (default 50) the claim owner or nearby players and operators get a message.
simpletweaks.guide.page.53.title: Ground item cleanup (T32)
simpletweaks.guide.page.53: Every intervalMinutes (default 15) ground items are cleared after a chat countdown; /simpletweaks cleanup now starts it at once (operators).
simpletweaks.guide.page.54.title: Chunk pregeneration (T33)
simpletweaks.guide.page.54: /simpletweaks pregen start <radius> [dimension] generates every chunk around the world border center; pause, resume, stop and status (operators of level 3).
simpletweaks.guide.page.55.title: Anti-X-Ray
simpletweaks.guide.page.55: Ores that touch no air, water or other see-through block are sent to players as their host stone (stone, deepslate, netherrack, end stone), so x-ray texture packs, x-ray mods and noclip cameras see no hidden ore.
simpletweaks.guide.page.56.title: Anti-X-Ray
simpletweaks.guide.page.57.title: Freecam rule
simpletweaks.guide.page.57: When the server turns it on (freecam.enabled, default off), players with the Freecam mod may still fly the camera, but not through blocks:
simpletweaks.guide.page.58.title: Freecam rule
simpletweaks.guide.page.58: Simple Tweaks on the client forces Freecam's block collision while connected to that server.
simpletweaks.guide.page.59.title: Further protections
simpletweaks.guide.page.59: Three more switches, each off by default:
simpletweaks.guide.page.60.title: Further protections
simpletweaks.guide.page.60: seedHash sends a random hashed seed to clients, hideHealth sends other players' health
simpletweaks.guide.page.61.title: Further protections
simpletweaks.guide.page.61: as their maximum, actionChecks reports reach and fast-break attempts to operators (no automatic punishment).
